title: A change in this recorded window
body: This live window shows an HRV dip during low movement. You can inspect the data or choose a check-in.

title: Optional context for this entry
body: A recent HRV dip was recorded during low movement. Add it as context only if it seems relevant to you.

title: A check-in from your current source
body: Your current source has recorded a fresh HRV-dip event. Review its data and decide whether a pause would be useful.

title: A recent check-in is available
body: A recent body-signal change is available to review. You can inspect it or dismiss this check-in.

title: Your daily check-in review is ready
body: Review your recorded body-signal changes beside how you said you felt. They describe different parts of your day.

title: Add context to your day if useful
body: Your body-signal record is ready to review. You can add how the day felt, or leave that context unknown.

title: Review how your day felt
body: Your self-report matters even when the detector shows no matching episode. Review or add context to your journal.

title: Activity adds context to your record
body: Some recorded activation overlapped a logged activity. Review that context before interpreting the daily total.

title: Your practice review is ready
body: Compare the recorded windows before and after your practice. A change in this session does not prove an effect.

title: Two views of the same moment
body: Your self-report and recorded body signal differed in this interval. Review the context without treating either as a diagnosis.

title: A timing pattern to review
body: Several covered days show body-signal changes in the same part of the day. Review what was happening before choosing any change.

title: Your weekly pattern looks different
body: The covered weeks show a different pattern of recorded activation. Review coverage and context alongside the comparison.

title: Your week has no clear timing pattern
body: The recorded episodes were spread across your covered days. Review the record without assuming a single routine explains it.

title: Your selected reflection is ready
body: The interval you selected is ready to review. Its summary describes recorded observations and the context you supplied.

title: Your journal question can be revisited
body: The comparison you asked about now has both explicit-answer groups. Review the evidence and its limits with your saved question.

title: Your water-log question is ready
body: The selected water-log interval is ready to review. Your saved question will use logged entries and leave missing intake unknown.

title: The source detail you asked for is ready
body: The selected value now has an available source record. Review it alongside your saved question.

title: Your journal-history question is ready
body: The selected question’s history is ready to review under its current label. Open your saved question for the details.

title: Your selected trend is ready to discuss
body: The interval you asked about is ready. Review the observed values and any remaining limits with your saved question.

title: Your question has updated evidence
body: The correction you requested is now reflected in the saved comparison. Review the revised evidence before drawing conclusions.

title: Return to your saved question
body: You asked to revisit a question at this time. Open it when you are ready.

title: Your selected follow-up is available
body: The follow-up you chose to resume is ready. Open the saved question to review its current evidence.

title: Your requested review is ready
body: The topics you selected are gathered into one review. Open them together when convenient.

title: Use the updated evidence
body: The earlier review is out of date. A newer view is ready to use with this question.

title: Your chosen commitment is due
body: This is the reminder you approved. Review the commitment, mark it done, or change your plan.

title: Prepare for your chosen step
body: You asked for a preparation reminder. Open the step you approved before deciding what to do.

title: How did your chosen step go?
body: You asked for a follow-up on your commitment. Record what happened, including a skip or a change of plan.

title: Your revised step is ready
body: This reminder follows the smaller step you approved. The previous version has been replaced.

title: Your rescheduled commitment
body: This is the later time you chose. Review the step or update the plan again if needed.

title: Review your trial commitment
body: The trial period you chose has ended. Review what helped and decide whether to continue.

title: Your chosen step is complete
body: You marked your success check complete. Review the commitment or close it here.

title: Review before you resume
body: Your chosen pause ends today. Review the commitment before deciding to resume reminders.

title: Revisit the step that did not fit
body: You asked to review an obstacle to this commitment. Change the step, choose another time, or close it.

title: Choose the version you want
body: Two versions of this commitment need your review. Select one before its reminders continue.

title: Your first habits review is ready
body: Review the habits you explicitly logged this week. This is a starting point, not a verdict on your routine.

title: A full week of journal observations
body: Your selected journal questions have answers on every day this week. Review what you noticed and what you want to keep tracking.

title: Compare your journal coverage
body: Some selected questions have more recorded days than others. Review coverage before comparing their patterns.

title: Your journal item joins the review
body: The review shows the first available answers for this item. Earlier behavior remains unknown.

title: Your habit records are together
body: Review your logged water and selected journal answers in one place. Their overlap does not show that one caused the other.

title: Review your shorter routine
body: Your weekly review follows the questions you chose to keep. Removed items are not treated as missed tasks.

title: Your review includes your choices
body: Explicitly skipped routine entries are shown separately from unlogged days. Review whether your reminder schedule still suits you.

title: One habit was consistent in your log
body: This item had the same recorded answer across its observed days. Review it as a pattern, not a yes-versus-no comparison.

title: Your two-week habit review is ready
body: Compare the same selected questions across two covered weeks. Review the observation counts alongside any differences.

title: Choose what to keep tracking
body: Review whether your selected questions still help you. Keep, hide, or revise the items you chose.

title: Your device battery is low
body: Your device reports 15% battery. Charge when convenient to keep collecting data.

title: Plan a device charge
body: Your device has roughly 20 hours of estimated battery left, based on its recent discharge. Plan a charge when it fits.

title: Check your device battery
body: The device reports 18% battery. Its roughly 19 hours estimate uses a typical runtime because personal discharge data is limited.

title: A device charge would be useful
body: Your device reports 13% battery with roughly 14 hours estimated remaining. One charge can address both warnings.

title: Check battery before your alarm
body: The current battery estimate may not cover your armed alarm time. Charge the device and review the alarm status.

title: Your chosen charge reminder
body: You asked for a charge reminder at this time. Check the current device battery before deciding what to do.

title: Battery needs your attention
body: The current device reports 12% battery. This view will update when a new reading arrives.

title: Your device reports charging
body: The latest reading confirms charging. Check the live battery view for progress.

title: Check battery after your recording
body: Your recording has ended and the device has a current charge warning. Review its battery details and charge when convenient.

title: Charge before using this device again
body: This device is reporting a low battery while off-body. Check its charge before relying on another recording.

title: Your device reports a full charge
body: The latest reading is 100%. Your current battery details are ready to review.

title: Your chosen charge target is reached
body: The device reached the 80% charge target you selected. Check its current status before disconnecting the charger.

title: Your battery estimate meets your target
body: The measured estimate now meets your selected 24-hour target. Runtime can vary, so review the current details.

title: Your device is charged for review
body: The device reports 100% and is currently off-body. Check it when you are ready to wear it again.

title: The device reports 100%
body: The latest battery reading is full. Your recording can stay on screen while you review details later.

title: Your charge target is reached
body: The current reading meets the target you selected. Review the battery details here.

title: Your device reports 100%
body: The latest battery reading is 100%. The charging state is unknown, so check the device details if you need confirmation.

title: Your requested charge check is complete
body: The device reached the charge target from your earlier request. Review the current battery when convenient.

title: Your charge update
body: The device reached your selected charge target earlier in this review window. Check the current reading before relying on the estimate.

title: Your top-up status is ready
body: The device now reports 62% after your top-up. Review the latest details before planning more recording.

title: Turn on Bluetooth to connect
body: Bluetooth is currently off. Turn it on, then return to your device connection.

title: Review Bluetooth access
body: The system reports that Bluetooth access is unavailable to Noop. Review access in Settings, then try the connection again.

title: Reconnect your selected device
body: The selected device is still disconnected. Check that it is nearby and use the connection controls here.

title: Check how the device is worn
body: The device reports that it is off-body. Check its fit if you are trying to collect live data.

title: Review the pairing guide
body: Repeated pairing attempts need attention. Follow the existing reconnect guide before trying again.

title: This source has no live check-in feed
body: Live HRV check-ins are unavailable for this source. Its supported historical views remain available.

title: Refresh the battery reading
body: The displayed battery reading is from yesterday at 16:10. Reconnect for a current reading; the estimate is not counting down from stale data.

title: Finish device time recovery
body: The device’s time recovery is still pending. Follow the connection guidance before relying on newly dated records.

title: Choose how to reconnect
body: Automatic reconnect attempts are paused. Review the device and choose whether to retry or use the pairing guide.

title: Choose a device for live data
body: No live device is selected for this view. Choose a source when you are ready to continue.

title: Today’s record is not available yet
body: The latest available record is dated October 19. Review your sources for newer data; yesterday’s values are not today’s results.

title: No readable samples in this range
body: No samples were returned for the selected range. Check available data and source settings without assuming a permission was denied.

title: Health data is temporarily unavailable
body: The system reports protected health data is unavailable. Return after unlocking the device to try the read again.

title: The live view needs a fresh reading
body: The most recent accepted sample is from 14:05. Check the active source before interpreting this as live data.

title: Your import contains earlier dates
body: This import ends on October 16. It adds history but does not supply a current-day record.

title: Your data is still being processed
body: The records were received, and their analysis is still pending. New results will appear after a verified calculation completes.

title: Your history task is paused
body: The history task is paused under the current execution conditions. Keep this view available if you want to continue now.

title: Choose your current data source
body: Your stored history is available, but no current source is selected. Choose the source you want to use for new data.

title: This value comes from another source
body: The displayed value comes from Apple Health for this day. Review its provenance before comparing it with another source.

title: Your edit is awaiting an updated result
body: The edit is saved. Its affected results are waiting for verified recomputation, so the previous values are not treated as current.

title: Review this source change
body: This comparison includes a change of source. Review each source’s records before interpreting a difference as a personal trend.

title: Check this journal answer
body: Imported and local answers differ for this item. The local explicit answer is being used; review it if that is not what you intended.

title: Review this journal unit change
body: Earlier values used a different unit. Review the record before comparing numbers under the new unit.

title: Review these similar water entries
body: These entries are close together and have the same amount. Keep both if intentional, or edit the log yourself.

title: Check the dates around your time change
body: Your local time zone changed while this view was open. Review the displayed local dates before comparing daily totals.

title: Compare like-for-like calculations
body: These records use different calculation versions. Choose a compatible range before interpreting the change.

title: Your journal history stays connected
body: Only this item’s display name changed. Earlier answers remain connected to the same journal question.

title: You are viewing an archived source
body: These are historical records from an archived source. They do not change the source selected for new observations.

title: Review this record’s date
body: This imported record is dated in the future. Review its source date before including it in current comparisons.

title: Your saved edit is being used
body: This view uses your verified edit for the selected day. The original source value remains available to review.

title: Your import review is ready
body: The import you requested has finished. Review its date coverage and included sources.

title: Your recalculated review is ready
body: The selected range has finished recalculating. Review the updated values and their calculation version.

title: Your journal review is ready
body: The comparison you requested is ready with its observation counts and limits. Open it when convenient.

title: Your source comparison is ready
body: The sources you selected are ready to compare separately. Review their coverage and measurement differences.

title: Your water-history review is ready
body: The water-log range you selected is ready to review. Missing logs remain unknown intake.

title: Your selected trend review is ready
body: The date range you requested is ready. Review its observed days, source, and calculation version.

title: Your battery-history review is ready
body: Review the device readings you selected and how its estimates were formed. Future runtime can still vary.

title: Your requested export is ready
body: The local export you requested is ready to review. Open it to decide what to do next.

title: Your combined review is ready
body: The items you selected are gathered in one completed review. Open the combined result when convenient.

title: Your result is updated
body: The verified result is now available in this view. Review the updated details here.
